WITH hand_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        p.bats,
        COUNT(*) as hand_count
    FROM appearances a
    JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY p.bats
),
totals AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(hand_count) as total_count,
        COUNT(*) as distinct_hands
    FROM hand_counts
)
SELECT 
    hand_counts.bats AS batting_hand,
    hand_counts.hand_count AS count,
    hand_counts.hand_count / totals.total_count AS share,
    hand_counts.hand_count / (totals.total_count / totals.distinct_hands) AS count_div_avg
FROM hand_counts
CROSS JOIN totals
